_about: Public-domain John Howe (1630-1705, Puritan, chaplain to Cromwell) for the Word Hoard: the Whole Works (London: F. Westley, 1822, ed. John Hunt, 8 vols). Vols. V-VIII are held clean from CCEL; vols. I-IV are raw Internet Archive OCR of the University of Toronto scans (volume numbers read off the title pages). Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 4 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
